rule: Atomic swap of manifest.json (+ new previews/portraits). Parts, materials, masks, fx and plates PNGs are byte-identical to v003; v002 coordinates remain invalid.

stage.note: v003.1 grows the DRAWING SURFACE, not the rig: the 640x640 rig frame and every manifest number are unchanged. Draw the rig translated by rig_origin inside an 800x800 stage (or allow overflow of 160 px above and 80 px on each side of the 640 frame). Victory and the A2 strike/follow-through/windup poses use this margin; idle and defeat stay inside the 640 frame. Mirror still happens about rig x=320 (stage x=400).

v003.1.rule: Each bot's portrait is rendered from THAT bot's own loadout: its paintId (paint_tokens[paintId], or the paint's hex composited material_under + tinted paint_mask + material_over) and its weaponId (pose poses.portrait[weaponId], drawing weapons[weaponId].asset with the normal grip/z rules). Never reuse or recolour the shipped sample PNGs; they are references for QA only. Re-render whenever paintId or weaponId changes (cache key: kit version + paintId/hex + weaponId + size).

portrait.sample_files: renamed: portraits/{loadoutId}-{px}.png (oxide-sword, petrol-axe, scrapgreen-dagger). The v003 oxide-*/petrol-* files are gone.

renderer_changes_required: Allocate the 800x800 stage (or allow overflow 160 px above / 80 px each side of the 640 rig frame) and translate the rig by stage.rig_origin. Victory and the A2 attack keys otherwise clip.
Play A2 sequences from timing.per_weapon[weaponId] (30 fps segments, eases, hit-stop on contact for both bots). Old motionPose names still resolve (pose_aliases).
Portraits: render per bot from its own paintId/hex + weaponId with poses.portrait[weaponId] and portrait.crop_rect_canvas_px; never reuse the sample PNGs.
Blend all rots linearly as before; v003.1 rots are stored so every part turns the short way from idle (the axe no longer swings through the floor between idle and windup).
